mapper.select: SELECT o.id AS id, o.voucher_id AS voucherId, v.title AS title, v.token_amount AS tokenAmount, o.status AS status, o.create_time AS createTime, CASE WHEN t.id IS NULL THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE END AS redeemed FROM tb_voucher_order o INNER JOIN tb_voucher v ON v.id = o.voucher_id AND v.token_amount > 0 LEFT JOIN tb_token_transaction t ON t.source_order_id = o.id AND t.type = 'TOKEN_PACK_REDEEM' WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY o.create_time DESC
